stages.label: Corridor resolves
stages.narrative: The selected route is separated into physical street segments before evidence is joined.

stages.label: Observations join
stages.narrative: Historical collision rows attach to physical segments while unmatched evidence remains unknown.

stages.label: Estimate derives
stages.narrative: Fixed sparse-count shrinkage stabilizes sparse counts without changing observed rows.

stages.label: Sensitivity ready
stages.narrative: Parameter changes can now be compared against the same historical observations.
